environment.name: SYMFONY__ENV__DOMAIN_NAME
environment.prompt: Address used to reach wallabag (http://IP or https://wallabag.example.com)

environment.name: SYMFONY__ENV__SERVER_NAME
environment.prompt: Name of this wallabag instance, shown in the interface and in 2FA codes

completion_notes: wallabag listens on port 80 of the container and stores its data in SQLite.

wallabag builds its links from the address given during the installation. If it does not match the address of the container, edit lxc.environment.runtime: SYMFONY__ENV__DOMAIN_NAME in /etc/pve/lxc/<CTID>.conf with the container stopped, and start it again.
